// MODULE engine/search.mjs
/** Public-web research orchestration. Adapters must enforce URL/DNS policy on redirects too. */
const SOURCE_CLASSES = Object.freeze(['manufacturer','wholesaler','national_retail','local_retail','marketplace','distributor','catalog']);
const TERMS = {manufacturer:'üretici resmi ürün',wholesaler:'toptan koli fiyat',national_retail:'market ürün fiyat stok',local_retail:'yerel market ürün fiyat',marketplace:'satın al fiyat',distributor:'distribütör ithalatçı ürün',catalog:'ürün katalog üretim'};
// Discovery seeds identify public domains only; access, extraction and prices remain unverified.
const ZAMAN_DISCOVERY_SEEDS=Object.freeze([
 {domain:'torku.com.tr',sourceClass:'manufacturer'}, {domain:'lezita.com.tr',sourceClass:'manufacturer'},
 {domain:'sutas.com.tr',sourceClass:'manufacturer'}, {domain:'bizimtoptan.com.tr',sourceClass:'wholesaler'},
 {domain:'bonservis.com',sourceClass:'wholesaler'}, {domain:'metro-tr.com',sourceClass:'wholesaler'},
 {domain:'guncelfiyatlar.metro-tr.com',sourceClass:'wholesaler'},
 {domain:'migros.com.tr',sourceClass:'national_retail'}, {domain:'carrefoursa.com',sourceClass:'national_retail'},
 {domain:'trendyol.com',sourceClass:'marketplace'}, {domain:'hepsiburada.com',sourceClass:'marketplace'},
 {domain:'torku.com.tr',sourceClass:'catalog'}, {domain:'lezita.com.tr',sourceClass:'catalog'},
 {domain:'brosurler.metro-tr.com',sourceClass:'catalog'}
]);
function buildResearchQueries(input, registry=[]) {
 const name=String(input?.name??input?.productName??'').trim();if(!name)throw TypeError('Product name is required');
 const pack=typeof input.packaging==='string'?input.packaging:typeof input.pack==='string'?input.pack:'';
 const identity=[input.brand,name,pack,input.barcode,input.productCode].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
 const variants=[...new Set([identity,...(Array.isArray(input.synonyms)?input.synonyms:[]).slice(0,4).map(alias=>[input.brand,alias,pack].filter(Boolean).join(' '))])];
 const queries=[];const seen=new Set();
 const push=task=>{const key=task.sourceClass+'|'+task.query;if(!seen.has(key)){seen.add(key);queries.push(task)}};
 // Round-robin intents ensure baseline coverage before synonyms and named-domain queries.
 for(const term of variants)for(const sourceClass of SOURCE_CLASSES)push({sourceClass,identityIntent:'requested',query:`${term} ${TERMS[sourceClass]}${input.region&&['local_retail','wholesaler','distributor'].includes(sourceClass)?' '+input.region:''}`});
 for(const token of [input.barcode,input.productCode].filter(Boolean))for(const sourceClass of ['manufacturer','wholesaler','catalog'])push({sourceClass,identityIntent:'identifier',query:`${token} ${input.brand??''} ${TERMS[sourceClass]}`.trim()});
 const groups=SOURCE_CLASSES.map(sourceClass=>registry.filter(source=>source.sourceClass===sourceClass));
 for(let i=0;i<100;i++)for(const group of groups){const source=group[i];if(!source)continue;const domain=new URL(validatePublicUrl('https://'+source.domain)).hostname;push({sourceClass:source.sourceClass,identityIntent:'requested',domain,query:`site:${domain} ${identity} ${source.sourceClass==='catalog'?'ürün katalog pdf':''} ${input.region??''}`.trim()})}
 if(input.includeAlternatives===true)for(const sourceClass of ['manufacturer','wholesaler','distributor'])push({sourceClass,identityIntent:'alternative_discovery',query:[input.category||name,input.form,input.specification,'alternatif muadil',TERMS[sourceClass],input.region].filter(Boolean).join(' ')});
 return queries;
}
function publicIPv4(host) {
  const p=host.split('.').map(Number); if(p.length!==4 || p.some(n=>!Number.isInteger(n)||n<0||n>255)) return false;
  return !(p[0]===0||p[0]===10||p[0]===127||p[0]>=224||p[0]===169&&p[1]===254||p[0]===172&&p[1]>=16&&p[1]<=31||p[0]===192&&[0,168].includes(p[1])||p[0]===192&&p[1]===88&&p[2]===99||p[0]===100&&p[1]>=64&&p[1]<=127||p[0]===198&&[18,19,51].includes(p[1])||p[0]===203&&p[1]===0);
}
function validatePublicUrl(value) {
  const url=new URL(value), host=url.hostname.toLowerCase().replace(/^\[|\]$/g,'').replace(/\.$/,'');
  if(!['http:','https:'].includes(url.protocol)||url.username||url.password||url.port&&!['80','443'].includes(url.port)) throw new Error('Unsafe URL protocol, credentials or port');
  if(host==='localhost'||!host.includes('.')||/\.(localhost|local|internal|test|invalid)$/.test(host)) throw new Error('Non-public host');
  if(host.includes(':')) throw new Error('IPv6 literals require adapter-level address validation');
  if(/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/.test(host)&&!publicIPv4(host)) throw new Error('Non-public IP');
  url.hash=''; return url.href;
}
async function assertResolvedPublic(url, resolveHost, signal) {
  if(typeof resolveHost!=='function') throw new Error('resolveHost adapter is required before fetching');
  const addresses=await resolveHost(new URL(url).hostname,{signal});
  if(!Array.isArray(addresses)||!addresses.length||addresses.some(a=>!publicIPv4(typeof a==='string'?a:a.address))) throw new Error('DNS resolution includes non-public or unsupported addresses');
}
function aborted(signal) { if(signal?.aborted) throw signal.reason ?? new Error('Cancelled'); }
async function attempt(operation, {signal,timeoutMs,retries}) {
  let last;
  for(let n=0;n<=retries;n++) {
    aborted(signal); const controller=new AbortController();
    const cancel=()=>controller.abort(signal.reason); signal?.addEventListener('abort',cancel,{once:true});
    let timer;
    try { return await Promise.race([Promise.resolve().then(()=>operation(controller.signal)),new Promise((_,reject)=>{timer=setTimeout(()=>{controller.abort();reject(new Error('Adapter timeout'));},timeoutMs);controller.signal.addEventListener('abort',()=>reject(controller.signal.reason??new Error('Cancelled')),{once:true});})]); }
    catch(error) { last=error; aborted(signal); }
    finally {clearTimeout(timer);signal?.removeEventListener('abort',cancel);}
  }
  throw last;
}
async function pool(items, concurrency, fn, signal) {
  let cursor=0; await Promise.all(Array.from({length:Math.min(concurrency,items.length)},async()=>{while(cursor<items.length){aborted(signal);const index=cursor++;await fn(items[index],index);}}));
}
/** No adapters means no live search: failure is explicit rather than fabricated. */
async function researchProduct(input, adapters={}, options={}) {
  const queries=buildResearchQueries(input,options.registry??[]);
  const concurrency=Math.floor(Math.max(1,Math.min(8,Number(options.concurrency)||3)));
  const retries=Math.floor(Math.max(0,Math.min(2,Number(options.retries)||0)));
  const timeoutMs=Math.max(50,Math.min(60000,Number(options.timeoutMs)||10000));
  const maxResults=Math.floor(Math.max(1,Math.min(100,Number(options.maxResults)||35)));
  const outerSignal=options.signal, errors=[], sources=[], observations=[];let signal=outerSignal;
  const startedAt=Date.now(),totalBudgetMs=Math.max(1,Math.min(170000,Number(options.totalBudgetMs)||170000)),searchBudgetMs=Math.max(1,Math.min(totalBudgetMs,Number(options.searchBudgetMs)||110000));
  const isDeadline=reason=>reason?.code==='RESEARCH_DEADLINE';
  async function phasePool(items,fn,budgetMs,stage){
   aborted(outerSignal);const phase=new AbortController(),stop=()=>phase.abort(outerSignal.reason);outerSignal?.addEventListener('abort',stop,{once:true});if(outerSignal?.aborted)stop();
   const deadline=Object.assign(Error('Research budget expired'),{code:'RESEARCH_DEADLINE',stage});const timer=setTimeout(()=>phase.abort(deadline),Math.max(1,budgetMs));signal=phase.signal;
   let cursor=0;
   try{await Promise.allSettled(Array.from({length:Math.min(concurrency,items.length)},async()=>{while(cursor<items.length&&!phase.signal.aborted){const item=items[cursor++];await fn(item)}}));
    if(outerSignal?.aborted&&!isDeadline(outerSignal.reason))throw outerSignal.reason??Error('Cancelled');
    if(phase.signal.aborted){if(!isDeadline(phase.signal.reason))throw phase.signal.reason;coverage.deadlineReached=true;coverage.deadlineStages.push(stage);errors.push({stage:'budget',message:'Time budget exhausted; remaining tasks were not executed',phase:stage});}
   }finally{clearTimeout(timer);outerSignal?.removeEventListener('abort',stop);signal=outerSignal;}
  }
  const coverage={status:'unavailable',scope:'configured queries only; not the entire web',queryCount:queries.length,queryAttempted:0,interruptedQueries:0,unexecutedQueries:queries.length,deadlineReached:false,deadlineStages:[],successfulQueries:0,failedQueries:0,discoveredSources:0,unfetchedSources:0,fetchAttempted:0,fetchSucceeded:0,fetchFailed:0,limits:{maxResults,perDomainBudget:Math.floor(Math.max(1,Math.min(100,Number(options.perDomainBudget)||5))),concurrency,totalBudgetMs,searchBudgetMs},truncatedHits:0,sourceClasses:SOURCE_CLASSES.map(sourceClass=>({sourceClass,status:'pending',queryCount:queries.filter(q=>q.sourceClass===sourceClass).length,queryAttempted:0,interruptedQueries:0,unexecutedQueries:0,successfulQueries:0,failedQueries:0,resultCount:0,discoveredSources:0,fetchAttempted:0,fetchSucceeded:0,fetchFailed:0,skippedSources:0}))};
  if(typeof adapters.search!=='function') return {queries,sources,observations,coverage,errors:[{stage:'configuration',message:'Search adapter is not configured'}]};
  await phasePool(queries,async task=>{
    const entry=coverage.sourceClasses.find(e=>e.sourceClass===task.sourceClass);coverage.queryAttempted++;entry.queryAttempted++;
    try {
      const result=await attempt(s=>adapters.search(task.query,{signal:s,sourceClass:task.sourceClass}),{signal,timeoutMs,retries});
      const hits=Array.isArray(result)?result:result?.results;
      if(!Array.isArray(hits)) throw new Error('Search adapter must return results array');
      coverage.successfulQueries++;entry.successfulQueries++;coverage.truncatedHits+=Math.max(0,hits.length-maxResults);entry.status=entry.status==='error'?'partial':hits.length?'searched':entry.resultCount?'searched':'no_results';entry.resultCount+=hits.length;
      for(const hit of hits.slice(0,maxResults)) {try{const url=validatePublicUrl(hit.url);const existing=sources.find(s=>s.url===url);if(existing){if(!existing.queryIntents.includes(task.sourceClass))existing.queryIntents.push(task.sourceClass);}else sources.push({url,title:hit.title??'',snippet:hit.snippet??'',queryIntents:[task.sourceClass],identityIntent:task.identityIntent??'requested',rank:sources.length,sourceClass:'unverified',discoveredAt:new Date().toISOString(),query:task.query});}catch(error){errors.push({stage:'url',sourceClass:task.sourceClass,message:error.message});}}
    } catch(error) {if(signal?.aborted){coverage.interruptedQueries++;entry.interruptedQueries++;}else{coverage.failedQueries++;entry.failedQueries++;entry.status='error';errors.push({stage:'search',sourceClass:task.sourceClass,message:error.message});}}
  },searchBudgetMs,'search');
  coverage.unexecutedQueries=queries.length-coverage.queryAttempted;
  sources.sort((a,b)=>a.rank-b.rank||a.url.localeCompare(b.url));
  for(const entry of coverage.sourceClasses){entry.unexecutedQueries=entry.queryCount-entry.queryAttempted;entry.discoveredSources=sources.filter(s=>s.queryIntents.includes(entry.sourceClass)).length;entry.status=entry.failedQueries?(entry.successfulQueries?'partial':'error'):entry.resultCount?'searched':'no_results';}
  coverage.discoveredSources=sources.length;
  const selected=[],selectedUrls=new Set(),domainCounts=new Map();
  const domainBudget=Math.floor(Math.max(1,Math.min(100,Number(options.perDomainBudget)||5)));
  let progress=true;while(selected.length<maxResults&&progress){progress=false;for(const intent of SOURCE_CLASSES){const candidate=sources.find(s=>s.queryIntents.includes(intent)&&!selectedUrls.has(s.url)&&(domainCounts.get(new URL(s.url).hostname)??0)<domainBudget);if(candidate&&selected.length<maxResults){selected.push(candidate);selectedUrls.add(candidate.url);const host=new URL(candidate.url).hostname;domainCounts.set(host,(domainCounts.get(host)??0)+1);progress=true;}}}
  const collectionBudgetMs=totalBudgetMs-(Date.now()-startedAt);coverage.selectedSources=selected.length;coverage.unexecutedFetches=selected.length;coverage.interruptedFetches=0;
  if(typeof adapters.fetchPage==='function'&&collectionBudgetMs>0&&!outerSignal?.aborted) await phasePool(selected,async source=>{
    coverage.fetchAttempted++;for(const intent of source.queryIntents)coverage.sourceClasses.find(e=>e.sourceClass===intent).fetchAttempted++;
    try {const page=await attempt(async s=>{await assertResolvedPublic(source.url,adapters.resolveHost,s);const result=await adapters.fetchPage(source.url,{signal:s});if(result?.finalUrl&&validatePublicUrl(result.finalUrl)!==source.url)await assertResolvedPublic(validatePublicUrl(result.finalUrl),adapters.resolveHost,s);return result;},{signal,timeoutMs,retries});
      const observedAt=new Date().toISOString();coverage.fetchSucceeded++;for(const intent of source.queryIntents)coverage.sourceClasses.find(e=>e.sourceClass===intent).fetchSucceeded++;observations.push({sourceUrl:source.url,queryIntents:source.queryIntents,sourceClass:'unverified',observedAt,checkedAt:observedAt,publishedAt:page?.publishedAt??null,evidence:typeof page==='string'?{text:page}:page,verification:'observed',productionStatus:'unverified'});
    }catch(error){if(signal?.aborted)coverage.interruptedFetches++;else{coverage.fetchFailed++;for(const intent of source.queryIntents)coverage.sourceClasses.find(e=>e.sourceClass===intent).fetchFailed++;errors.push({stage:'fetch',url:source.url,message:error.message});}}
  },collectionBudgetMs,'collection');
  if(outerSignal?.aborted&&!isDeadline(outerSignal.reason))throw outerSignal.reason??Error('Cancelled');
  coverage.unexecutedFetches=selected.length-coverage.fetchAttempted;coverage.incompleteSourceReads=coverage.fetchFailed+coverage.interruptedFetches+coverage.unexecutedFetches;coverage.elapsedMs=Date.now()-startedAt;
  coverage.unfetchedSources=sources.length-coverage.fetchAttempted;for(const entry of coverage.sourceClasses)entry.skippedSources=entry.discoveredSources-entry.fetchAttempted;
  coverage.status=coverage.successfulQueries===0?'unavailable':coverage.failedQueries||coverage.fetchFailed||typeof adapters.fetchPage==='function'&&coverage.unfetchedSources?'partial':typeof adapters.fetchPage==='function'?'completed':'discovery_only';
  if(coverage.successfulQueries&&!sources.length)coverage.status=coverage.failedQueries?'partial_no_results':'no_results';
  if(coverage.deadlineReached||coverage.unexecutedQueries||coverage.interruptedQueries||coverage.interruptedFetches)coverage.status='partial_deadline';
  return {queries,sources,observations,coverage,errors};
}

// MODULE engine/verification.mjs
/** Product/evidence rules. Pure functions: no network, persistence or inferred facts. */
const normalizeText = value => String(value ?? '').normalize('NFKC').toLocaleLowerCase('tr-TR').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();

/** Normalize a declared pack; unknown fields remain null, never default to one. */
function normalizePack(pack = {}) {
  if(!pack||typeof pack!=='object'||Array.isArray(pack))pack={};
  const unit = normalizeText(pack.unit);
  const scales = { g: ['kg', 0.001], gr: ['kg', 0.001], kg: ['kg', 1], ml: ['l', 0.001], lt: ['l', 1], l: ['l', 1], litre: ['l', 1], adet: ['each', 1], each: ['each', 1], unit: ['each', 1], piece: ['each', 1] };
  const scale = scales[unit];
  const amount = Number(pack.amount);
  const count = Number(pack.count);
  return { unit: scale?.[0] ?? null, amount: scale && Number.isFinite(amount) && amount > 0 ? amount * scale[1] : null, count: Number.isInteger(count) && count > 0 ? count : null };
}

/** Compare identities. Name similarity alone cannot establish exact identity. */
function matchProduct(left = {}, right = {}) {
  const reasons = [];
  const barcode = value => String(value ?? '').replace(/\s/g, '');
  const a = barcode(left.barcode), b = barcode(right.barcode);
  const brandA = normalizeText(left.brand), brandB = normalizeText(right.brand);
  const codeA = normalizeText(left.productCode), codeB = normalizeText(right.productCode);
  const packA = normalizePack(left.packBasis??left.pack), packB = normalizePack(right.packBasis??right.pack);
  const packKnown = ['unit', 'amount', 'count'].every(key => packA[key] !== null && packB[key] !== null);
  const packEqual = packKnown && ['unit', 'amount', 'count'].every(key => packA[key] === packB[key]);
  const packConflict = ['unit', 'amount', 'count'].some(key => packA[key] !== null && packB[key] !== null && packA[key] !== packB[key]);
  const brandConflict = brandA && brandB && brandA !== brandB;
  if (a && b && a !== b) reasons.push('barcode_mismatch');
  if (brandConflict) reasons.push('brand_mismatch');
  if (brandA&&brandA===brandB&&codeA&&codeB&&codeA!==codeB) reasons.push('product_code_mismatch');
  if (packConflict) reasons.push('pack_mismatch');
  for (const key of ['category', 'form', 'specification']) {
    const leftValue = normalizeText(left[key]), rightValue = normalizeText(right[key]);
    if (leftValue && rightValue && leftValue !== rightValue) reasons.push(`${key}_mismatch`);
  }
  if (a && b && a === b) {
    if (reasons.length) return { kind: 'conflict', reasons: ['same_barcode_inconsistent_attributes', ...reasons] };
    return { kind: 'exact', reasons: ['same_barcode'] };
  }
  if (!reasons.length && brandA && brandA === brandB && codeA && codeA === codeB && packEqual) return { kind: 'exact', reasons: ['same_brand_code_pack'] };
  // Equivalence requires explicit comparable attributes; no guess from matching words.
  const comparable = ['category', 'form', 'specification'].every(key => normalizeText(left[key]) && normalizeText(left[key]) === normalizeText(right[key]));
  if (comparable) return { kind: 'alternative', reasons: ['same_declared_category_form_specification', ...reasons] };
  return { kind: 'unresolved', reasons: reasons.length ? reasons : ['insufficient_identity'] };
}

/** Keep collection time separate from source publication time. */
/** @param {any} observation @param {{now?:string,maxAgeMs?:number}} options */
function assessFreshness(observation, { now, maxAgeMs } = {}) {
  const observedAt = Date.parse(observation?.observedAt);
  const referenceTime = Date.parse(now);
  if (!Number.isFinite(referenceTime) || !Number.isFinite(maxAgeMs) || maxAgeMs < 0) throw new TypeError('now and nonnegative maxAgeMs are required');
  const publishedAt = observation?.publishedAt ? Date.parse(observation.publishedAt) : NaN;
  return {
    collection: !Number.isFinite(observedAt) ? 'unknown' : observedAt > referenceTime ? 'invalid_future' : referenceTime - observedAt > maxAgeMs ? 'stale' : 'recent',
    publication: !Number.isFinite(publishedAt) ? 'unknown' : publishedAt > referenceTime ? 'invalid_future' : referenceTime - publishedAt > maxAgeMs ? 'stale' : 'recent',
    publisherFreshnessProven: Number.isFinite(publishedAt) && publishedAt <= referenceTime && referenceTime - publishedAt <= maxAgeMs,
  };
}

/** Summarize one claim from evidence. A source absence is not a negative claim.
 * Evidence shape: {id, claim, value, sourceId, independenceKey, authority,
 * directConfirmation, observedAt, publishedAt, expired}. Authorities for production:
 * manufacturer or verified_manufacturer_contact. Retail evidence may establish stock.
 */
function evaluateClaim(evidence = [], claim) {
  const allowed = { production: ['active', 'discontinued'], stock: ['available', 'unavailable'] };
  if (!allowed[claim]) throw new TypeError('Unsupported claim');
  const candidates = evidence.filter(item => item.claim === claim && !item.expired && allowed[claim].includes(item.value));
  const eligible = candidates.filter(item => claim !== 'production' || ['manufacturer', 'verified_manufacturer_contact'].includes(item.authority));
  const values = [...new Set(eligible.map(item => item.value))];
  const groups = [...new Set(eligible.map(item => item.independenceKey).filter(Boolean))];
  return {
    claim,
    state: values.length > 1 ? 'conflict' : values[0] ?? 'unknown',
    verification: values.length > 1 ? 'conflicting' : !values.length ? 'unverified' : eligible.some(item => item.directConfirmation === true) ? 'directly_confirmed' : groups.length > 1 ? 'corroborated' : 'observed',
    evidenceIds: eligible.map(item => item.id).filter(Boolean),
    excludedEvidenceIds: candidates.filter(item => !eligible.includes(item)).map(item => item.id).filter(Boolean),
    independentSourceCount: groups.length,
  };
}

/** Production and market stock remain independent dimensions. */
function verifyProduct(evidence = []) {
  return { production: evaluateClaim(evidence, 'production'), stock: evaluateClaim(evidence, 'stock') };
}

// MODULE engine/commerce.mjs
/** Exact decimal arithmetic. Decimal inputs must be strings or safe integers.
 * Money is rounded half away from zero to minor units; no binary floats.
 */
function decimal(value) {
  if (typeof value === 'number' && !Number.isSafeInteger(value)) throw new Error('Use a decimal string');
  const text = String(value);
  if (!/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(text)) throw new Error('Expected nonnegative decimal');
  const [whole, fraction = ''] = text.split('.');
  return { n: BigInt(whole + fraction), d: 10n ** BigInt(fraction.length) };
}
/** @param {bigint} n @param {bigint} d @returns {bigint} */
function round(n, d) { return (n + d / 2n) / d; }
function cents(value) { const v = decimal(value); return round(v.n * 100n, v.d); }
/** @param {bigint} value */
function money(value) { const sign = value < 0n ? '-' : ''; const abs = value < 0n ? -value : value; return `${sign}${abs / 100n}.${String(abs % 100n).padStart(2, '0')}`; }
function percent(value) { const p = decimal(value); if (p.n > 100n * p.d) throw new Error('Percentage exceeds 100'); return p; }
/** @param {bigint} value @param {string|number} quantity */
function scale(value, quantity) { const q = decimal(quantity); return round(value * q.n, q.d); }
/** @param {bigint} value @param {string|number} rate */
function applyRate(value, rate) { const p = percent(rate); return round(value * p.n, p.d * 100n); }
/** @type {Record<string, [string, bigint]>} */
const UNITS = { kg: ['mass', 1n], g: ['mass', 1000n], litre: ['volume', 1n], l: ['volume', 1n], ml: ['volume', 1000n], unit: ['count', 1n], adet: ['count', 1n] };

/** Normalize a complete priced package, not a guessed package.
 * {productId,currency,price,quantity,unit,vatIncluded,vatRate?,freight?}
 * quantity is total kg/g/litre/ml/unit in the priced package. Unknown VAT
 * produces comparable:false; kg, litre and count never cross dimensions.
 */
function normalizeOffer(offer) {
  if (!offer.productId || !/^[A-Z]{3}$/.test(offer.currency ?? '')) throw new Error('Product identity and currency required');
  const unit = UNITS[offer.unit]; if (!unit) throw new Error('Unsupported or ambiguous unit');
  const q = decimal(offer.quantity); if (!q.n) throw new Error('Quantity must be positive');
  const gross = cents(offer.price);
  const base = { productId: offer.productId, currency: offer.currency, dimension: unit[0], normalizedUnit: {mass:'kg',volume:'litre',count:'unit'}[unit[0]] };
  if (typeof offer.vatIncluded !== 'boolean' || (offer.vatIncluded && offer.vatRate == null)) return {...base, comparable:false, reason:'VAT basis unknown'};
  let net = gross;
  if (offer.vatIncluded) { const p = percent(offer.vatRate); net = round(gross * p.d * 100n, p.d * 100n + p.n); }
  // Freight must explicitly be net on the same currency and allocated package.
  if (offer.freight != null && offer.freightNet !== true) return {...base, comparable:false, reason:'Freight VAT basis unknown'};
  const landed = net + cents(offer.freight ?? '0');
  return {...base, comparable:true, netPackagePrice:money(net), landedPackagePrice:money(landed), netUnitPrice:money(round(landed * q.d * unit[1], q.n)), comparisonBasis:'net landed cost'};
}

/** Compare only exact product identities, matching currency/dimension and net
 * landed cost. Alternatives require explicit human selection, not this API. */
function compareOffers(offers) {
  const normalized = offers.map(normalizeOffer);
  if (!normalized.length) return [];
  const first = normalized[0];
  if (normalized.some(o => !o.comparable || o.productId !== first.productId || o.currency !== first.currency || o.dimension !== first.dimension)) throw new Error('Incompatible comparison');
  return normalized.sort((a,b) => cents(a.netUnitPrice) < cents(b.netUnitPrice) ? -1 : cents(a.netUnitPrice) > cents(b.netUnitPrice) ? 1 : 0);
}

/** Prepare a draft only, never send or order.
 * {currency,lines:[{productId,quantity,unitNetSale,unitNetCost,vatRate}],
 * customerDiscountPercent?,freightNetCost?,freightNetSale?,freightVatRate?}
 * Customer discount is allocated across line totals using largest remainders.
 * VAT rounds per discounted line. Unknown VAT means total including VAT:null.
 */
function createProposalDraft(input) {
  if (!/^[A-Z]{3}$/.test(input.currency ?? '') || !Array.isArray(input.lines) || !input.lines.length) throw new Error('Currency and lines required');
  /** @type {Array<{index:number,productId:string,sale:bigint,cost:bigint,vatRate?:string|number}>} */
  const rows = input.lines.map((l,index) => {
    if (!l.productId || Object.hasOwn(l,'discountPercent')) throw new Error('Product required; line discounts forbidden');
    const q = decimal(l.quantity); if (!q.n) throw new Error('Positive quantity required');
    return {index, productId:l.productId, sale:scale(cents(l.unitNetSale),l.quantity),cost:scale(cents(l.unitNetCost),l.quantity),vatRate:l.vatRate};
  });
  const subtotal = rows.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.sale,0n);
  const discount = applyRate(subtotal,input.customerDiscountPercent ?? '0');
  /** @type {Array<{index:number,productId:string,sale:bigint,cost:bigint,vatRate?:string|number,discount:bigint,remainder:bigint}>} */
  const allocations = rows.map(r => ({...r,discount:subtotal ? discount*r.sale/subtotal : 0n,remainder:subtotal ? discount*r.sale%subtotal : 0n}));
  let remaining = discount - allocations.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.discount,0n);
  for (const r of [...allocations].sort((a,b)=>a.remainder === b.remainder ? a.index-b.index : a.remainder>b.remainder ? -1:1)) { if (!remaining) break; r.discount++; remaining--; }
  const freightSale = cents(input.freightNetSale ?? '0');
  const netSales = subtotal-discount+freightSale;
  const cost = rows.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.cost,0n)+cents(input.freightNetCost ?? '0');
  const knownVat = rows.every(r=>r.vatRate != null) && (!freightSale || input.freightVatRate != null);
  const vat = knownVat ? allocations.reduce((a,r)=>a+applyRate(r.sale-r.discount,r.vatRate),0n)+(freightSale ? applyRate(freightSale,input.freightVatRate) : 0n) : null;
  const profit = netSales-cost;
  /** @param {bigint} denominator */
  const ratio = denominator => denominator ? `${profit < 0n ? '-' : ''}${money(round((profit < 0n ? -profit : profit)*10000n,denominator))}` : null;
  return {status:'draft',requiresHumanApproval:true,currency:input.currency,subtotalNet:money(subtotal),customerDiscount:money(discount),freightNetSale:money(freightSale),netSales:money(netSales),netCost:money(cost),profitNet:money(profit),marginPercent:ratio(netSales),markupPercent:ratio(cost),vat:vat==null?null:money(vat),totalIncludingVat:vat==null?null:money(netSales+vat),lines:allocations.map(r=>({productId:r.productId,subtotalNet:money(r.sale),allocatedCustomerDiscount:money(r.discount),netSale:money(r.sale-r.discount),vat:r.vatRate==null?null:money(applyRate(r.sale-r.discount,r.vatRate))}))};
}

// MODULE engine/orchestrator.mjs
/** Registry trust is exact-host and product-brand scoped; discovery intent is never authority. */
function normalizeObservationClaims(observation, product, identity, options={}) {
 if(identity.kind!=='exact')return [];
 let host;try{host=new URL(observation.sourceUrl).hostname.toLowerCase();}catch{return [];}
 const registry=(options.registry??[]).find(source=>String(source.domain??'').toLowerCase()===host);
 const brand=String(product.brand??'').trim().toLocaleLowerCase('tr-TR');
 const manufacturer=registry?.verifiedManufacturer===true && Array.isArray(registry.brands) && registry.brands.some(value=>String(value).trim().toLocaleLowerCase('tr-TR')===brand);
 const now=options.now??new Date().toISOString();
 const freshness=assessFreshness({observedAt:observation.observedAt??observation.checkedAt,publishedAt:observation.publishedAt},{now,maxAgeMs:options.maxAgeMs??86400000});
 return (Array.isArray(product.claims)?product.claims:[]).filter(claim=>claim && ['production','stock'].includes(claim.claim)).map((claim,index)=>{
  const until=claim.validUntil?Date.parse(claim.validUntil):NaN;
  return {id:`${observation.sourceUrl}#${product.barcode??product.name}-${index}`,claim:claim.claim,value:claim.value,
   sourceId:observation.sourceUrl,independenceKey:registry?.independenceKey??null,
   authority:manufacturer?'manufacturer':'unverified',directConfirmation:false,
   observedAt:observation.observedAt??observation.checkedAt,publishedAt:observation.publishedAt??null,
   expired:freshness.collection!=='recent'||freshness.publication==='stale'||freshness.publication==='invalid_future'||Boolean(claim.validUntil)&&(!Number.isFinite(until)||until<Date.parse(now))};
 });
}
/** Evidence stays observational. Public web prices never become committed purchase costs. */
async function runTradeResearch(input,adapters,options={}) {
 const research=await researchProduct(input,adapters,options);
 const now=options.now??new Date().toISOString();
 const claims=[];
 const records=research.observations.map((observation,index)=>{
  const observedAt=observation.observedAt??observation.checkedAt;
  const products=observation.evidence?.products??[];
  return {id:`observation-${index}`,sourceUrl:observation.sourceUrl,observedAt,publishedAt:observation.publishedAt,
   freshness:assessFreshness({observedAt,publishedAt:observation.publishedAt},{now,maxAgeMs:options.maxAgeMs??86400000}),
   products:products.map(p=>{const identity=matchProduct(input,{...p,productCode:p.productCode??p.sku});const evidence=normalizeObservationClaims(observation,p,identity,{...options,now});claims.push(...evidence);return {...p,identity,status:verifyProduct(evidence),productionStatus:verifyProduct(evidence).production.state};}),
   verification:'observed',rawEvidence:observation.evidence};
 });
 const productRecordCount=records.reduce((n,r)=>n+r.products.length,0);
 const resultState=research.coverage.status==='unavailable'?'configuration_required':!research.sources.length?(research.coverage.failedQueries||research.coverage.deadlineReached||research.coverage.unexecutedQueries?'partial_evidence':'no_results'):!productRecordCount?'partial_evidence':'waiting_human';
 const humanTasks=[];
 if(!records.length)humanTasks.push({type:'source_configuration_or_access',reason:'No product page evidence was obtained'});
 for(const record of records){if(!record.freshness.publisherFreshnessProven)humanTasks.push({type:'confirm_current_price',sourceUrl:record.sourceUrl});
  for(const p of record.products)if(p.identity.kind!=='exact')humanTasks.push({type:'confirm_product_identity',sourceUrl:record.sourceUrl,name:p.name,reason:p.identity.reasons});}
 const productStatus=verifyProduct(claims);
 if(productRecordCount&&['unknown','conflict'].includes(productStatus.production.state))humanTasks.push({type:'confirm_production',reason:productStatus.production.state==='conflict'?'Conflicting manufacturer evidence':'No current trusted manufacturer claim'});
 if(productStatus.stock.state==='conflict')humanTasks.push({type:'resolve_stock_conflict',reason:'Stock claims disagree across sources; inspect seller-specific stock'});
 if(productRecordCount)humanTasks.push({type:'confirm_commercial_terms',reason:'Stock, VAT, freight, minimum order, payment and delivery require evidence'});
 return {version:1,input,coverage:research.coverage,sources:research.sources,records,errors:research.errors,
  productStatus,claims,humanTasks,externalActions:[],productRecordCount,status:resultState,partialEvidence:resultState==='partial_evidence'||research.coverage.status==='partial_deadline',
  notice:'Research observations are not a confirmed purchasing or sales commitment.'};
}

// MODULE engine/needs.mjs
/** Conservative needs import. Plain text remains a name; structured headers establish fields. */
const aliases = {name:['name','ürün','urun','ürün adı','urun adi','product'],quantity:['quantity','miktar'],unit:['unit','birim'],brand:['brand','marka'],barcode:['barcode','barkod'],packaging:['packaging','ambalaj']};
const norm = value => String(value??'').trim().toLocaleLowerCase('tr-TR');
function parseDelimited(text, delimiter) {
 const rows=[];let row=[],cell='',quoted=false;
 for(let i=0;i<text.length;i++){const c=text[i];if(c==='"'){if(quoted&&text[i+1]==='"'){cell+='"';i++;}else if(!quoted&&cell.trim())throw new TypeError('Unexpected quote');else quoted=!quoted;}
 else if(c===delimiter&&!quoted){row.push(cell);cell='';}
 else if((c==='\n'||c==='\r')&&!quoted){if(c==='\r'&&text[i+1]==='\n')i++;row.push(cell);if(row.some(x=>x.trim()))rows.push(row);row=[];cell='';}
 else cell+=c;}
 if(quoted)throw new TypeError('Unclosed quoted cell');row.push(cell);if(row.some(x=>x.trim()))rows.push(row);return rows;
}
function normalizeRow(raw,index){
 const issues=[];const result={id:`need-${index+1}`,name:String(raw.name??'').trim(),quantity:null,unit:null,brand:null,barcode:null,packaging:null};
 for(const key of ['unit','brand','barcode','packaging'])result[key]=String(raw[key]??'').trim()||null;
 const q=String(raw.quantity??'').trim();if(q){if(/^\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?$/.test(q)&&!/^\d{1,3}\.\d{3}$/.test(q)&&Number(q.replace(',','.'))>0)result.quantity=Number(q.replace(',','.'));else issues.push('ambiguous_quantity');}
 if(!result.name)issues.push('missing_name');if(result.quantity===null)issues.push('missing_quantity');if(!result.unit)issues.push('missing_unit');
 return {...result,issues,raw};
}
/** input string or array of objects; format text/csv/tsv and optional delimiter. */
/** @param {any} input @param {{format?:string,delimiter?:string}} options */
function importNeeds(input,{format='text',delimiter}={}) {
 if(Array.isArray(input))return {rows:input.map(normalizeRow),format:'rows'};
 if(typeof input!=='string')throw new TypeError('Needs input must be text or object rows');
 if(format==='text')return {rows:input.split(/\r?\n/).map(name=>name.trim()).filter(Boolean).map((name,i)=>normalizeRow({name},i)),format};
 if(!['csv','tsv'].includes(format))throw new TypeError('Unsupported needs format');
 const sep=delimiter??(format==='tsv'?'\t':',');if(sep.length!==1)throw new TypeError('Single character delimiter required');
 const data=parseDelimited(input.replace(/^\uFEFF/,''),sep);if(!data.length)return {rows:[],format};
 const fields=data[0].map(header=>Object.keys(aliases).find(key=>aliases[key].includes(norm(header)))??null);
 if(!fields.includes('name'))throw new TypeError('Structured import requires a product name header');
 const named=fields.filter(Boolean);if(new Set(named).size!==named.length)throw new TypeError('Duplicate mapped column');
 return {format,rows:data.slice(1).map((cells,i)=>{const raw={};fields.forEach((key,j)=>{if(key)raw[key]=cells[j]??'';});const result=normalizeRow(raw,i);if(cells.length!==fields.length)result.issues.push('column_count_mismatch');return result;})};
}

// MODULE engine/transfer.mjs

/** Pure, owner-reviewed transfer into existing workspace rows/offers.
 * selection: {rowId,supplierId,observationId,sourceUrl,reason,workspaceCurrency,
 * offer:{productId,currency,price,quantity,unit,vatIncluded,vatRate?,freight?,freightNet?},
 * rowUnitQuantity:'1', replaceExisting?:true,
 * confirmations:{productMatch,packBasis,vatBasis,currency,shipping}: all true}
 * rowUnitQuantity means base kg/litre/unit per ONE existing row unit. It must
 * be reviewed explicitly; never inferred from a product name or quantityMilli.
 * actor:{id,role:'owner'}. Result {document,audit}; input is never mutated.
 * Does not persist, send, change supplier selection, quantity, VAT or sale fields.
 */
/** @param {any} document @param {any} selection @param {any} actor @param {{now?:string}} options */
function applyReviewedResearchPrice(document, selection, actor, { now = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
  if (actor?.role !== 'owner' || !actor.id) throw new Error('OWNER_REQUIRED');
  if (!document || !Array.isArray(document.rows) || !Array.isArray(document.suppliers)) throw new Error('INVALID_WORKSPACE');
  if (document.status && !['draft','taslak'].includes(document.status)) throw new Error('DRAFT_REQUIRED');
  if (!selection || !selection.reason?.trim() || !selection.observationId || !selection.sourceUrl) throw new Error('AUDIT_REASON_AND_SOURCE_REQUIRED');
  let url; try { url=new URL(selection.sourceUrl); } catch { throw new Error('INVALID_SOURCE_URL'); }
  if (!['https:','http:'].includes(url.protocol) || url.username || url.password) throw new Error('INVALID_SOURCE_URL');
  const stamp = Date.parse(now); if (!Number.isFinite(stamp)) throw new Error('INVALID_TIME');
  for (const key of ['productMatch','packBasis','vatBasis','currency','shipping']) if (selection.confirmations?.[key] !== true) throw new Error(`CONFIRM_${key.toUpperCase()}_REQUIRED`);
  const row=document.rows.find(r=>r.id===selection.rowId);
  if (!row || !document.suppliers.some(s=>s.id===selection.supplierId)) throw new Error('ROW_OR_SUPPLIER_NOT_FOUND');
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(row.quantityMilli) || row.quantityMilli <= 0 || !row.offers) throw new Error('INVALID_ROW');
  if (row.productId && row.productId !== selection.offer?.productId) throw new Error('PRODUCT_MISMATCH');
  const workspaceCurrency=document.quoteSettings?.currency||document.currency||'TRY';
  if (workspaceCurrency !== selection.workspaceCurrency) throw new Error('WORKSPACE_CURRENCY_MISMATCH');
  if (selection.workspaceCurrency !== selection.offer?.currency) throw new Error('CURRENCY_MISMATCH');
  if (selection.offer.freight == null) throw new Error('EXPLICIT_FREIGHT_REQUIRED');
  const normalized=normalizeOffer(selection.offer);
  if (!normalized.comparable || !('landedPackagePrice' in normalized) || typeof normalized.landedPackagePrice !== 'string' || !/^\d+\.\d{2}$/.test(normalized.landedPackagePrice)) throw new Error('NET_COST_NOT_VERIFIED');
  const knownRowUnit=UNITS[String(row.unit||'').trim().toLocaleLowerCase('tr-TR')];
  if(knownRowUnit&&knownRowUnit[0]!==normalized.dimension)throw new Error('ROW_UNIT_DIMENSION_MISMATCH');
  const quantity=String(selection.rowUnitQuantity ?? '');
  if (!/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(quantity)) throw new Error('EXPLICIT_ROW_UNIT_BASIS_REQUIRED');
  const [whole,fraction='']=quantity.split('.');const q=BigInt(whole+fraction), divisor=10n**BigInt(fraction.length);
  if (!q) throw new Error('EXPLICIT_ROW_UNIT_BASIS_REQUIRED');
  // Compute directly from full landed package cost to avoid multiplying a
  // prematurely rounded per-kg cost for larger row packages.
  const pq=String(selection.offer.quantity), [pw,pf='']=pq.split('.');
  const packageAmount=BigInt(pw+pf), packageDivisor=10n**BigInt(pf.length);
  const unitScale=['g','ml'].includes(selection.offer.unit)?1000n:1n;
  const packageCents=BigInt(normalized.landedPackagePrice.replace('.',''));
  const numerator=packageCents*q*packageDivisor*unitScale, denominator=divisor*packageAmount;
  const cost=Number((numerator+denominator/2n)/denominator);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(cost) || cost<0 || cost>100000000) throw new Error('COST_LIMIT');
  const old=row.offers[selection.supplierId];
  if (old && selection.replaceExisting !== true) throw new Error('EXISTING_OFFER_REQUIRES_EXPLICIT_REPLACEMENT');
  const next=structuredClone(document);
  const target=next.rows.find(r=>r.id===selection.rowId);
  let preservedSaleCents=null;
  if(selection.supplierId===row.selectedSupplierId&&['markup','margin'].includes(row.saleMode)){const oldCost=row.offers[row.selectedSupplierId]?.costCents,rate=row.markupBps;if(!Number.isSafeInteger(oldCost)||oldCost<0||!Number.isSafeInteger(rate)||rate<0||row.saleMode==='margin'&&rate>=10000)throw Error('EXISTING_SALE_BASIS_REQUIRED');preservedSaleCents=Number(row.saleMode==='margin'?round(BigInt(oldCost)*10000n,BigInt(10000-rate)):round(BigInt(oldCost)*BigInt(10000+rate),10000n));if(!Number.isSafeInteger(preservedSaleCents)||preservedSaleCents>100000000)throw Error('SALE_PRICE_LIMIT');target.saleMode='fixed';target.fixedSaleCents=preservedSaleCents;}
  target.offers[selection.supplierId]={...(old??{}),costCents:cost};
  return {document:next,audit:{action:'reviewed_research_cost_transfer',previousSaleMode:row.saleMode||null,preservedSaleCents,actorId:actor.id,at:new Date(stamp).toISOString(),rowId:row.id,supplierId:selection.supplierId,observationId:selection.observationId,sourceUrl:selection.sourceUrl,reason:selection.reason.trim(),oldCostCents:old?.costCents??null,newCostCents:cost,currency:selection.workspaceCurrency,productId:selection.offer.productId,rowUnit:row.unit,rowUnitQuantity:quantity,normalizedUnit:normalized.normalizedUnit,confirmations:{...selection.confirmations},reviewedOffer:structuredClone(selection.offer),priceKind:'human_reviewed_quote',sourceObservationLinkOnly:true,status:'draft',externalActions:[]}};
}

// MODULE integration/zaman-intelligence.mjs
/** Private ZAMAN seam. Call only after existing authentication, Origin and CSRF middleware. */
/** Preserve explicitly declared research identity. Text packaging never proves a pack basis. */
function normalizeResearchProduct(product){
 const invalid=()=>{throw Object.assign(Error('INVALID_PRODUCT'),{status:400})};
 if(!product||typeof product!=='object'||Array.isArray(product))invalid();
 const text=(value,max=500)=>{if(typeof value!=='string'||value.length>max||/[\u0000-\u001f]/.test(value))invalid();return value.trim()};
 const out={};for(const field of ['name','brand','barcode','pack','region','rowId'])out[field]=text(field==='pack'&&product.pack&&typeof product.pack==='object'?'':product[field]??'',field==='name'?220:500);
 if(!out.name)invalid();
 for(const field of ['productCode','category','form','specification','packaging']){let value=product[field];if(field==='productCode'&&value==null)value=product.sku;if(value!=null)out[field]=text(value);}
 if(product.packaging==null&&typeof product.pack==='object'&&product.pack!==null)out.packaging='';
 const declared=product.packBasis??(product.pack&&typeof product.pack==='object'?product.pack:null);
 if(declared!=null){
  if(typeof declared!=='object'||Array.isArray(declared))invalid();
  const pack={};if(declared.unit!=null){pack.unit=text(declared.unit,20).toLocaleLowerCase('tr-TR');if(!['kg','g','gr','l','lt','litre','ml','adet','unit','each','piece'].includes(pack.unit))invalid();}
  for(const field of ['amount','count'])if(declared[field]!=null){const value=declared[field];if(typeof value!=='number'||!Number.isFinite(value)||value<=0||value>100000000||(field==='count'&&!Number.isSafeInteger(value)))invalid();pack[field]=value;}
  if(!Object.keys(pack).length)invalid();out.packBasis=pack;
 }
 if(product.synonyms!=null){if(!Array.isArray(product.synonyms)||product.synonyms.length>8)invalid();out.synonyms=[...new Set(product.synonyms.map(v=>text(v,220)).filter(Boolean))];}
 if(product.includeAlternatives!=null){if(typeof product.includeAlternatives!=='boolean')invalid();out.includeAlternatives=product.includeAlternatives;}
 return out;
}

function createIntelligenceRouter({repository,queue,verifyWorkspace,researchConfigured=typeof queue?.send==='function',now=()=>new Date().toISOString(),uuid=()=>crypto.randomUUID()}){
 const workspaceExists=(owner,id)=>typeof verifyWorkspace==='function'?verifyWorkspace(owner,id):repository?.workspaceExists?.(owner,id);
 const response=(data,status=200)=>new Response(JSON.stringify(data),{status,headers:{'content-type':'application/json; charset=utf-8','cache-control':'private, no-store','x-robots-tag':'noindex, nofollow, noarchive'}});
 const safeId=s=>typeof s==='string'&&/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}$/.test(s);
 async function body(request){const reader=request.body?.getReader();let size=0,chunks=[];if(reader)try{for(;;){const {done,value}=await reader.read();if(done)break;size+=value.byteLength;if(size>32000){await reader.cancel();throw Object.assign(Error('PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE'),{status:413})}chunks.push(value)}}finally{reader.releaseLock()}const bytes=new Uint8Array(size);let offset=0;for(const chunk of chunks){bytes.set(chunk,offset);offset+=chunk.length}let b;try{b=JSON.parse(new TextDecoder('utf-8',{fatal:true,ignoreBOM:false}).decode(bytes))}catch{throw Object.assign(Error('INVALID_JSON'),{status:400})}if(!b||typeof b!=='object'||Array.isArray(b))throw Object.assign(Error('INVALID_JSON'),{status:400});return b}
 return async function intelligenceRoute(request,context){try{
  const {auth,securityVerified}=context||{};
  if(auth?.user?.role!=='owner'||!auth.user.id)return response({ok:false,error:'OWNER_ONLY'},403);
  const write=!['GET','HEAD'].includes(request.method);
  if(securityVerified?.session!==true||(write&&(securityVerified.origin!==true||securityVerified.csrf!==true)))return response({ok:false,error:'MIDDLEWARE_REQUIRED'},403);
  const url=new URL(request.url),parts=url.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean);
  if(parts.slice(0,3).join('/')!=='api/workspace/intelligence')return response({ok:false,error:'NOT_FOUND'},404);
  if(!repository)return response({ok:false,error:'INTELLIGENCE_NOT_CONFIGURED'},503);
  const ownerId=String(auth.user.id),resource=parts[3],id=parts[4],action=parts[5];
  if(resource==='capabilities'&&parts.length===4&&request.method==='GET')return response({ok:true,data:{configured:researchConfigured&&typeof queue?.send==='function',execution:'background',commercialActions:'human_instruction_required'}});
  if(resource!=='jobs'||parts.length>6||id&&!safeId(id))return response({ok:false,error:'NOT_FOUND'},404);
  if(request.method==='POST'&&((parts.length===4)||action==='retry')&&(!researchConfigured||typeof queue?.send!=='function'))return response({ok:false,error:'INTELLIGENCE_NOT_CONFIGURED',message:'ZAMAN araştırma servisleri ve görev kuyruğu tamamlanmadan araştırma başlatılamaz.'},503);
  if(parts.length===4&&request.method==='GET'){const standalone=url.searchParams.get('scope')==='standalone';if(standalone&&url.searchParams.has('workspaceId'))return response({ok:false,error:'INVALID_SCOPE'},400);const workspaceId=standalone?null:url.searchParams.get('workspaceId');if(!standalone&&(!safeId(workspaceId)||!await workspaceExists(ownerId,workspaceId)))return response({ok:false,error:'WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND'},404);const limit=Number(url.searchParams.get('limit')||50);if(!Number.isSafeInteger(limit)||limit<1||limit>100)return response({ok:false,error:'INVALID_PAGE_LIMIT'},400);let cursor=null;if(url.searchParams.has('cursor')){try{const raw=url.searchParams.get('cursor');if(raw.length>500)throw Error();cursor=JSON.parse(raw);if(!cursor||!safeId(cursor.id)||typeof cursor.createdAt!=='string'||cursor.createdAt.length>40||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(cursor.createdAt)))throw Error()}catch{return response({ok:false,error:'INVALID_PAGE_CURSOR'},400)}}const page=await repository.historyPage(ownerId,{workspaceId,standalone,limit,cursor});return response({ok:true,data:page.items,page:{hasMore:page.hasMore,nextCursor:page.nextCursor}})}
  if(parts.length===4&&request.method==='POST'){
   const b=await body(request),query=typeof b.query==='string'?b.query.trim():'';
   if(!query||query.length>2000)return response({ok:false,error:'INVALID_QUERY'},400);
   const standalone=b.scope==='standalone';
   if(b.scope!=null&&!['standalone','workspace'].includes(b.scope))return response({ok:false,error:'INVALID_SCOPE'},400);
   if(standalone&&b.workspaceId!=null)return response({ok:false,error:'INVALID_SCOPE'},400);
   const workspaceId=standalone?null:b.workspaceId;if(!standalone&&!safeId(workspaceId))return response({ok:false,error:'WORKSPACE_REQUIRED'},400);
   if(!standalone&&!await workspaceExists(ownerId,workspaceId))return response({ok:false,error:'WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND'},404);
   const product=b.product;if(!product||typeof product!=='object'||Array.isArray(product)||typeof product.name!=='string'||!product.name.trim()||product.name.length>220)return response({ok:false,error:'INVALID_PRODUCT'},400);
   const normalizedProduct=normalizeResearchProduct(product);
   const key=b.idempotencyKey;if(!safeId(key))return response({ok:false,error:'INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY'},400);
   const existing=await repository.findByKey(ownerId,key);
   if(existing){if(existing.query!==query||existing.workspaceId!==workspaceId||JSON.stringify(existing.product)!==JSON.stringify(normalizedProduct))return response({ok:false,error:'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT'},409);if(existing.status==='queued'){try{await queue.send({jobId:existing.id,ownerId})}catch{await repository.recordDispatchFailure?.(ownerId,existing.id);return response({ok:false,error:'QUEUE_DISPATCH_FAILED',jobId:existing.id,retryable:true},503)}}return response({ok:true,data:existing,reused:true},200)}
   if(standalone&&normalizedProduct.rowId)return response({ok:false,error:'INVALID_SCOPE'},400);
   const job={id:uuid(),ownerId,workspaceId,scope:standalone?'standalone':'workspace',product:normalizedProduct,query,idempotencyKey:key,status:'queued',createdAt:now(),updatedAt:now(),revision:1};
   const saved=await repository.create(job);
   if(saved.query!==query||saved.workspaceId!==workspaceId||JSON.stringify(saved.product)!==JSON.stringify(normalizedProduct))return response({ok:false,error:'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT'},409);
   // Persisted queued jobs are recoverable if queue delivery fails; retry same key re-enqueues.
   try{await queue.send({jobId:saved.id,ownerId})}catch{await repository.recordDispatchFailure?.(ownerId,saved.id);return response({ok:false,error:'QUEUE_DISPATCH_FAILED',jobId:saved.id,retryable:true},503)}
   return response({ok:true,data:saved},202);
  }
  if(!id)return response({ok:false,error:'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED'},405);
  const job=await repository.get(ownerId,id);if(!job)return response({ok:false,error:'NOT_FOUND'},404);
  if(!action&&request.method==='GET')return response({ok:true,data:job});
  if(action==='evidence'&&request.method==='GET'){const evidence=await repository.evidence(ownerId,id);return response({ok:true,data:evidence})}
  if(action==='retry'&&request.method==='POST'){const b=await body(request);if(!Number.isSafeInteger(b.revision)||b.revision<1)return response({ok:false,error:'INVALID_REVISION'},400);const recovered=await repository.recover(ownerId,id,b.revision,now());if(!recovered)return response({ok:false,error:'REVISION_OR_STATE_CONFLICT'},409);try{await queue.send({ownerId,jobId:id})}catch{await repository.recordDispatchFailure(ownerId,id);return response({ok:false,error:'QUEUE_DISPATCH_FAILED',jobId:id,retryable:true},503)}return response({ok:true,data:recovered},202)}
  if(action==='confirm'&&request.method==='POST'){
   const b=await body(request);if(!Number.isSafeInteger(b.revision)||b.revision<1||typeof b.note!=='string'||!b.note.trim()||b.note.length>5000||typeof b.source!=='string'||!b.source.trim()||b.source.length>500)return response({ok:false,error:'INVALID_CONFIRMATION'},400);
   if(typeof repository.appendConfirmation!=='function')return response({ok:false,error:'CONFIRMATION_NOT_CONFIGURED'},503);
   const confirmed=await repository.appendConfirmation(ownerId,id,b.revision,{id:uuid(),kind:'human_confirmation',note:b.note.trim(),source:b.source.trim(),confirmedBy:ownerId,confirmedAt:now()},now());
   if(!confirmed)return response({ok:false,error:'REVISION_OR_STATE_CONFLICT'},409);return response({ok:true,data:confirmed});
  }
  if(action==='cancel'&&request.method==='POST'){
   const b=await body(request);if(!Number.isSafeInteger(b.revision)||b.revision<1)return response({ok:false,error:'INVALID_REVISION'},400);
   const cancelled=await repository.cancel(ownerId,id,b.revision,now());if(!cancelled)return response({ok:false,error:'REVISION_OR_STATE_CONFLICT'},409);
   return response({ok:true,data:cancelled});
  }
  return response({ok:false,error:'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED'},405);
 }catch(e){return response({ok:false,error:e.status?e.message:'INTELLIGENCE_OPERATION_FAILED'},e.status||500)}};
}

const INTELLIGENCE_MIGRATIONS=[
 `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oky_intelligence_audit_v1(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,job_id TEXT NOT NULL,action TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL)`,
 `CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS oky_intelligence_audit_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON oky_intelligence_audit_v1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'IMMUTABLE_AUDIT'); END`,
 `CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS oky_intelligence_audit_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON oky_intelligence_audit_v1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'IMMUTABLE_AUDIT'); END`,
 `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oky_intelligence_jobs_v1(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL,query TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(owner_id,idempotency_key))`,
 `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_oky_intelligence_owner_job ON oky_intelligence_jobs_v1(owner_id,id)`,
 `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_oky_intelligence_owner_history ON oky_intelligence_jobs_v1(owner_id,created_at DESC,id DESC)`,
 `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oky_intelligence_evidence_v1(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,job_id TEXT NOT NULL,owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL)`,
 `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_oky_intelligence_evidence_job ON oky_intelligence_evidence_v1(owner_id,job_id,id)`
];
function createD1IntelligenceRepository(DB){
 if(!DB?.prepare)throw Error('INTELLIGENCE_DB_BINDING_MISSING');
 const decode=r=>r?{...JSON.parse(r.payload_json),status:r.status,revision:r.revision,updatedAt:r.updated_at,confirmations:JSON.parse(r.confirmations_json||'[]')}:null;
 const selectJobs="SELECT j.*,COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json(e.payload_json)) FROM oky_intelligence_evidence_v1 e WHERE e.owner_id=j.owner_id AND e.job_id=j.id AND json_extract(e.payload_json,'$.kind')='human_confirmation'),'[]') confirmations_json FROM oky_intelligence_jobs_v1 j";
 const get=async(owner,id)=>decode(await DB.prepare(selectJobs+' WHERE j.owner_id=? AND j.id=?').bind(owner,id).first());
 const findByKey=async(owner,key)=>decode(await DB.prepare('SELECT * FROM oky_intelligence_jobs_v1 WHERE owner_id=? AND idempotency_key=?').bind(owner,key).first());
 return {get,findByKey,
  async historyPage(owner,{workspaceId=null,standalone=false,limit=50,cursor=null}={}){let sql=selectJobs+" WHERE j.owner_id=?";const args=[owner];if(standalone)sql+=" AND json_extract(j.payload_json,'$.scope')='standalone'";else{sql+=" AND json_extract(j.payload_json,'$.workspaceId')=?";args.push(workspaceId)}if(cursor){sql+=" AND (j.created_at<? OR (j.created_at=? AND j.id<?))";args.push(cursor.createdAt,cursor.createdAt,cursor.id)}sql+=" ORDER BY j.created_at DESC,j.id DESC LIMIT ?";args.push(limit+1);const rows=(await DB.prepare(sql).bind(...args).all()).results||[];const more=rows.length>limit,items=rows.slice(0,limit);const last=items.at(-1);return {items:items.map(decode),hasMore:more,nextCursor:more?{createdAt:last.created_at,id:last.id}:null}},
  async recover(owner,id,revision,at){const rows=await DB.batch([DB.prepare("UPDATE oky_intelligence_jobs_v1 SET status='queued',revision=revision+1,updated_at=?,payload_json=json_set(payload_json,'$.attempts',0,'$.lastError',NULL) WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND revision=? AND (status IN ('queued','failed','configuration_required') OR (status='running' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oky_intelligence_leases_v1 WHERE owner_id=? AND job_id=? AND expires_at>?)))").bind(at,owner,id,revision,owner,id,at),DB.prepare("INSERT INTO oky_intelligence_audit_v1(owner_id,job_id,action,created_at) SELECT ?,?,'OWNER_RECOVERY',? WHERE changes()>0").bind(owner,id,at),DB.prepare("DELETE FROM oky_intelligence_leases_v1 WHERE owner_id=? AND job_id=? AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oky_intelligence_jobs_v1 WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND revision=? AND status='queued')").bind(owner,id,owner,id,revision+1)]);return rows[0].meta?.changes?get(owner,id):null},
  async standaloneJobs(owner){return ((await DB.prepare(selectJobs+" WHERE j.owner_id=? AND json_extract(j.payload_json,'$.scope')='standalone' ORDER BY j.created_at DESC LIMIT 100").bind(owner).all()).results||[]).map(decode)},
  async workspaceJobs(owner,id){return ((await DB.prepare(selectJobs+" WHERE j.owner_id=? AND json_extract(j.payload_json,'$.workspaceId')=? ORDER BY j.created_at DESC LIMIT 100").bind(owner,id).all()).results||[]).map(decode)},
  async workspaceExists(owner,id){return !!await DB.prepare("SELECT id FROM oky_workspace_documents_v1 WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND kind IN ('draft','procurement')").bind(owner,id).first()},
  async appendConfirmation(owner,id,revision,evidence,at){const rows=await DB.batch([DB.prepare("UPDATE oky_intelligence_jobs_v1 SET revision=revision+1,updated_at=? WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND revision=? AND status<>'cancelled'").bind(at,owner,id,revision),DB.prepare("INSERT INTO oky_intelligence_evidence_v1(id,job_id,owner_id,payload_json,created_at) SELECT ?,?,?,?,? WHERE changes()>0").bind(evidence.id,id,owner,JSON.stringify(evidence),at),DB.prepare("INSERT INTO oky_intelligence_audit_v1(owner_id,job_id,action,created_at) SELECT ?,?,'HUMAN_CONFIRM',? WHERE changes()>0").bind(owner,id,at)]);return rows[0].meta?.changes?get(owner,id):null},
  async migrate(){for(const sql of INTELLIGENCE_MIGRATIONS)await DB.prepare(sql).run()},
  async create(job){await DB.batch([DB.prepare('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO oky_intelligence_jobs_v1(id,owner_id,idempotency_key,query,status,revision,payload_json,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)').bind(job.id,job.ownerId,job.idempotencyKey,job.query,job.status,job.revision,JSON.stringify(job),job.createdAt,job.updatedAt),DB.prepare("INSERT INTO oky_intelligence_audit_v1(owner_id,job_id,action,created_at) SELECT ?,?,'CREATE',? WHERE changes()>0").bind(job.ownerId,job.id,job.createdAt)]);return findByKey(job.ownerId,job.idempotencyKey)},
  async recordDispatchFailure(owner,id){await DB.prepare("INSERT INTO oky_intelligence_audit_v1(owner_id,job_id,action,created_at) SELECT owner_id,id,'DISPATCH_FAILURE',? FROM oky_intelligence_jobs_v1 WHERE owner_id=? AND id=?").bind(new Date().toISOString(),owner,id).run()},
  async cancel(owner,id,revision,at){const results=await DB.batch([DB.prepare("UPDATE oky_intelligence_jobs_v1 SET status='cancelled',revision=revision+1,updated_at=? WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND revision=? AND status IN ('queued','running','waiting_human')").bind(at,owner,id,revision),DB.prepare("INSERT INTO oky_intelligence_audit_v1(owner_id,job_id,action,created_at) SELECT ?,?,'CANCEL',? WHERE changes()>0").bind(owner,id,at)]);return results[0].meta?.changes?get(owner,id):null},
  async evidence(owner,id){const rows=(await DB.prepare('SELECT payload_json FROM oky_intelligence_evidence_v1 WHERE owner_id=? AND job_id=? ORDER BY id LIMIT 1000').bind(owner,id).all()).results||[];return rows.map(x=>JSON.parse(x.payload_json))}
 };
}

/** Worker adapter: leases are separate immutable-token guards; no browser credentials enter runner. */
const WORKER_MIGRATIONS=[`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oky_intelligence_leases_v1(job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,token TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL)`];
function createD1QueueStore(DB){
 return {
 async state(owner,id){return (await DB.prepare('SELECT status FROM oky_intelligence_jobs_v1 WHERE owner_id=? AND id=?').bind(owner,id).first())?.status||null},
 async migrate(){for(const sql of WORKER_MIGRATIONS)await DB.prepare(sql).run()},
 async claim(ownerId,jobId,token,at,expiresAt){
  const results=await DB.batch([
   DB.prepare("INSERT INTO oky_intelligence_leases_v1(job_id,owner_id,token,expires_at) SELECT id,owner_id,?,? FROM oky_intelligence_jobs_v1 WHERE id=? AND owner_id=? AND status IN ('queued','running') ON CONFLICT(job_id) DO UPDATE SET token=excluded.token,expires_at=excluded.expires_at WHERE oky_intelligence_leases_v1.expires_at<=?").bind(token,expiresAt,jobId,ownerId,at),
   DB.prepare("UPDATE oky_intelligence_jobs_v1 SET status='running',revision=revision+1,updated_at=?,payload_json=json_set(payload_json,'$.attempts',COALESCE(json_extract(payload_json,'$.attempts'),0)+1) WHERE id=? AND owner_id=? AND status IN ('queued','running') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oky_intelligence_leases_v1 WHERE job_id=? AND owner_id=? AND token=?)").bind(at,jobId,ownerId,jobId,ownerId,token),
   DB.prepare("INSERT INTO oky_intelligence_audit_v1(owner_id,job_id,action,created_at) SELECT ?,?,'CLAIM',? WHERE changes()>0").bind(ownerId,jobId,at)
  ]);if(!results[1]?.meta?.changes)return null;
  const row=await DB.prepare('SELECT * FROM oky_intelligence_jobs_v1 WHERE owner_id=? AND id=?').bind(ownerId,jobId).first();return row?{...JSON.parse(row.payload_json),status:row.status,revision:row.revision}:null;
 },
 async finish(ownerId,jobId,token,result,at){
  const facts=Array.isArray(result.evidence)?result.evidence:[],statements=[];const terminalStatus=['waiting_human','configuration_required','no_results','partial_evidence'].includes(result.status)?result.status:'completed';
  for(let i=0;i<facts.length;i++)statements.push(DB.prepare("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO oky_intelligence_evidence_v1(id,job_id,owner_id,payload_json,created_at) SELECT ?,?,?,?,? WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oky_intelligence_jobs_v1 j JOIN oky_intelligence_leases_v1 l ON l.job_id=j.id AND l.owner_id=j.owner_id WHERE j.id=? AND j.owner_id=? AND j.status='running' AND l.token=? AND l.expires_at>?)").bind(jobId+'_'+token+'_'+i,jobId,ownerId,JSON.stringify(facts[i]),at,jobId,ownerId,token,at));
  statements.push(DB.prepare("UPDATE oky_intelligence_jobs_v1 SET status=?,revision=revision+1,payload_json=json_set(payload_json,'$.result',json(?)),updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND owner_id=? AND status='running' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oky_intelligence_leases_v1 WHERE job_id=? AND owner_id=? AND token=? AND expires_at>?)").bind(terminalStatus,JSON.stringify(result),at,jobId,ownerId,jobId,ownerId,token,at));
  const updateIndex=statements.length-1;statements.push(DB.prepare("INSERT INTO oky_intelligence_audit_v1(owner_id,job_id,action,created_at) SELECT ?,?,'FINISH',? WHERE changes()>0").bind(ownerId,jobId,at));const rows=await DB.batch(statements);return !!rows[updateIndex]?.meta?.changes;
 },
 async fail(ownerId,jobId,token,at,errorCode='RESEARCH_OPERATION_FAILED'){const rows=await DB.batch([DB.prepare("UPDATE oky_intelligence_jobs_v1 SET status=CASE WHEN COALESCE(json_extract(payload_json,'$.attempts'),0)>=5 THEN 'failed' ELSE 'queued' END,revision=revision+1,updated_at=?,payload_json=json_set(payload_json,'$.lastError',?,'$.lastFailureAt',?) WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND status='running' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oky_intelligence_leases_v1 WHERE job_id=? AND owner_id=? AND token=?)").bind(at,errorCode,at,ownerId,jobId,jobId,ownerId,token),DB.prepare("INSERT INTO oky_intelligence_audit_v1(owner_id,job_id,action,created_at) SELECT owner_id,id,CASE WHEN status='failed' THEN 'FAILED_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED' ELSE 'RETRY' END,? FROM oky_intelligence_jobs_v1 WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND changes()>0").bind(at,ownerId,jobId),DB.prepare('DELETE FROM oky_intelligence_leases_v1 WHERE owner_id=? AND job_id=? AND token=?').bind(ownerId,jobId,token)]);return rows[0].meta?.changes?this.state(ownerId,jobId):null}

 };
}
function createIntelligenceQueueConsumer({store,runResearch,now=()=>Date.now(),uuid=()=>crypto.randomUUID(),leaseMs=300000}){
 if(!store||typeof runResearch!=='function')throw Error('WORKER_NOT_CONFIGURED');
 return async function consume(message){const b=message.body;if(!b||typeof b.ownerId!=='string'||typeof b.jobId!=='string'){message.ack();return}const token=uuid(),at=new Date(now()).toISOString(),expires=new Date(now()+leaseMs).toISOString();let job;
 try{job=await store.claim(b.ownerId,b.jobId,token,at,expires);if(!job){const state=await store.state(b.ownerId,b.jobId);if(!state||!['queued','running'].includes(state))message.ack();else message.retry({delaySeconds:30});return}}catch{message.retry({delaySeconds:30});return}
 try{if((job.attempts||0)>5)throw Error('RESEARCH_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED');const result=await runResearch({query:job.query,product:job.product,workspaceId:job.workspaceId,jobId:job.id,ownerId:b.ownerId});const finished=await store.finish(b.ownerId,b.jobId,token,result,new Date(now()).toISOString());if(!finished){const state=await store.state(b.ownerId,b.jobId);if(state==='running'||state==='queued'){message.retry({delaySeconds:30});return}}message.ack()}catch{try{const state=await store.fail(b.ownerId,b.jobId,token,new Date(now()).toISOString());if(state==='failed'||state==='cancelled'){message.ack();return}}catch{}message.retry({delaySeconds:Math.min(300,30*Math.max(1,job.attempts||1))})}
 };
}

// MODULE integration/reviewed-transfer.mjs
/** Atomically persists a human reviewed cost only in the same authoritative D1. */
async function persistReviewedTransfer(DB,repository,ownerId,jobId,input){
 const job=await repository.get(ownerId,jobId);if(!job||!job.workspaceId)throw Error('WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND');if(job.status==='cancelled')throw Error('RESEARCH_CANCELLED');
 const row=await DB.prepare("SELECT * FROM oky_workspace_documents_v1 WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND kind='draft'").bind(ownerId,job.workspaceId).first();
 if(!row)throw Error('WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND');if(input.revision!==row.revision)throw Error('REVISION_OR_STATE_CONFLICT');
 const selection=input.selection;if(!selection||selection.rowId!==job.product?.rowId)throw Error('RESEARCH_ROW_MISMATCH');
 const record=job.result?.records?.find(r=>r.id===selection.observationId&&r.sourceUrl===selection.sourceUrl);if(!record)throw Error('SOURCE_EVIDENCE_NOT_FOUND');
 const doc={...JSON.parse(row.payload_json),id:row.id,revision:row.revision};
 const result=applyReviewedResearchPrice(doc,selection,{id:ownerId,role:'owner'});
 const next={...result.document,revision:row.revision+1};
 const at=result.audit.at;
 const sql=[DB.prepare("INSERT INTO oky_intelligence_evidence_v1(id,job_id,owner_id,payload_json,created_at) SELECT ?,?,?,?,? WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oky_workspace_documents_v1 WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND revision=?) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oky_intelligence_jobs_v1 WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND revision=? AND status<>'cancelled')").bind(crypto.randomUUID(),jobId,ownerId,JSON.stringify(result.audit),at,ownerId,row.id,row.revision,ownerId,jobId,job.revision),
 DB.prepare("INSERT INTO oky_intelligence_audit_v1(owner_id,job_id,action,created_at) SELECT ?,?,'REVIEWED_COST_TRANSFER',? WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oky_workspace_documents_v1 WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND revision=?) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oky_intelligence_jobs_v1 WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND revision=? AND status<>'cancelled')").bind(ownerId,jobId,at,ownerId,row.id,row.revision,ownerId,jobId,job.revision),
 DB.prepare("UPDATE oky_workspace_documents_v1 SET payload_json=?,revision=revision+1,updated_at=? WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND revision=? AND kind='draft' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oky_intelligence_jobs_v1 WHERE owner_id=? AND id=? AND revision=? AND status<>'cancelled')").bind(JSON.stringify(next),at,ownerId,row.id,row.revision,ownerId,jobId,job.revision)];
 const saved=await DB.batch(sql);if(!saved.at(-1)?.meta?.changes)throw Error('REVISION_OR_STATE_CONFLICT');
 return {document:next,audit:result.audit};
}

// MODULE adapters/public-web.mjs

function approved(url, domains) {
  const normalized=validatePublicUrl(url),host=new URL(normalized).hostname.toLowerCase();
  if(!domains.some(d=>host===d || host.endsWith('.'+d))) throw new Error('Source domain is outside configured allowlist');
  return normalized;
}
async function resolvePublic(url,resolveHost,signal) {
  if(typeof resolveHost!=='function') throw new Error('Public DNS resolver is not configured');
  const addresses=await resolveHost(new URL(url).hostname,{signal});
  if(!Array.isArray(addresses)||!addresses.length) throw new Error('DNS returned no addresses');
  for(const item of addresses){const a=typeof item==='string'?item:item.address;if(!/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/.test(a??''))throw new Error('Unsupported DNS address family');validatePublicUrl('https://'+a);}
}
async function boundedText(response,maxBytes,signal) {
  const declared=Number(response.headers.get('content-length'));
  if(Number.isFinite(declared)&&declared>maxBytes){await response.body?.cancel();throw new Error('Response exceeds configured byte limit');}
  if(!response.body?.getReader)throw new Error('Streaming response body is required');
  const reader=response.body.getReader(),decoder=new TextDecoder();let total=0,text='';
  try{while(true){if(signal.aborted)throw new Error('Request cancelled');const {done,value}=await reader.read();if(done)break;total+=value.byteLength;if(total>maxBytes)throw new Error('Response exceeds configured byte limit');text+=decoder.decode(value,{stream:true});}return text+decoder.decode();}
  finally{await reader.cancel().catch(()=>{});reader.releaseLock();}
}
function plain(value,max=4000){return String(value??'').replace(/<[^>]*>/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,max);}
/** Extracts published JSON-LD statements; these do not establish current production or stock. */
function extractProductEvidence(html) {
  const nodes=[],errors=[];const scripts=html.matchAll(/<script\b[^>]*\btype\s*=\s*["']application\/ld\+json["'][^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script\s*>/gi);
  const visit=(value,depth=0)=>{if(depth>25||nodes.length>2000)return;if(Array.isArray(value)){for(const v of value)visit(v,depth+1);}else if(value&&typeof value==='object'){nodes.push(value);for(const [key,v]of Object.entries(value))if(key!=='@context')visit(v,depth+1);}};
  for(const match of scripts){try{visit(JSON.parse(match[1]));}catch{errors.push('Malformed JSON-LD block');}}
  const products=nodes.filter(n=>[n['@type']].flat().some(t=>String(t).split(/[\/#]/).pop()==='Product')).slice(0,100).map(p=>({
    name:plain(p.name,500),sku:plain(p.sku,160),barcode:plain(p.gtin??p.gtin13??p.gtin14??p.gtin12??p.gtin8,100),brand:plain(typeof p.brand==='object'?p.brand?.name:p.brand,160),manufacturer:plain(typeof p.manufacturer==='object'?p.manufacturer?.name:p.manufacturer,300),description:plain(p.description),
    offers:[p.offers].flat().filter(o=>o&&typeof o==='object').slice(0,100).map(o=>({price:o.price==null?null:String(o.price).slice(0,100),lowPrice:o.lowPrice==null?null:String(o.lowPrice).slice(0,100),highPrice:o.highPrice==null?null:String(o.highPrice).slice(0,100),currency:plain(o.priceCurrency,10),availability:plain(o.availability,300),priceValidUntil:plain(o.priceValidUntil,100),seller:plain(typeof o.seller==='object'?o.seller?.name:o.seller,300),url:plain(o.url,2000),type:plain(o['@type'],100)})),
    productionStatus:'unverified',verification:'observed'
  }));
  return {products,parseWarnings:errors,publishedAt:null,title:plain(/<title\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/title>/i.exec(html)?.[1],500)};
}
/** Generic search API contract: POST {query,sourceClass,limit}, JSON {results:[{url,title,snippet}]}. */
function createPublicWebAdapters(config={}, dependencies={}) {
  const fetchImpl=dependencies.fetch??globalThis.fetch,resolveHost=dependencies.resolveHost;
  const timeoutMs=Math.max(100,Math.min(60000,Number(config.timeoutMs)||12000));
  const maxBytes=Math.max(1024,Math.min(8*1024*1024,Number(config.maxResponseBytes)||2*1024*1024));
  const domains=(config.sourceDomains??[]).map(d=>String(d).toLowerCase().replace(/^\.+|\.+$/g,''));
  if(typeof fetchImpl!=='function')throw new Error('Fetch implementation is not configured');
  /** @param {string} url @param {{signal?:AbortSignal,headers?:Record<string,string>,method?:string,body?:string,allowedDomains:string[],maxRedirects?:number}} options */
  async function request(url,{signal,headers={},method='GET',body,allowedDomains,maxRedirects=0}){
    const controller=new AbortController(),cancel=()=>controller.abort();signal?.addEventListener('abort',cancel,{once:true});if(signal?.aborted)controller.abort();
    const timer=setTimeout(()=>controller.abort(),timeoutMs);
    try{let target=approved(url,allowedDomains);for(let n=0;;n++){
      if(controller.signal.aborted)throw new Error('Request cancelled or timed out');
      await resolvePublic(target,resolveHost,controller.signal);
      let response;try{response=await fetchImpl(target,{method,headers,body,signal:controller.signal,redirect:'manual',credentials:'omit'});}catch{throw new Error('Network request failed');}
      if([301,302,303,307,308].includes(response.status)){await response.body?.cancel();if(n>=maxRedirects)throw new Error('Redirect limit exceeded');const location=response.headers.get('location');if(!location)throw new Error('Redirect has no location');target=approved(new URL(location,target).href,allowedDomains);continue;}
      if(!response.ok){await response.body?.cancel();throw new Error('Source returned HTTP '+response.status);}
      const contentType=response.headers.get('content-type')??'';
      return {text:await boundedText(response,maxBytes,controller.signal),finalUrl:target,contentType};
    }}finally{clearTimeout(timer);signal?.removeEventListener('abort',cancel);}
  }
  return {
    resolveHost,
    /** @param {string} query @param {{signal?:AbortSignal,sourceClass?:string}} options */
    async search(query,{signal,sourceClass}={}){
      if(!config.searchEndpoint)throw new Error('SEARCH_API endpoint is not configured');
      const endpoint=validatePublicUrl(config.searchEndpoint);if(new URL(endpoint).protocol!=='https:')throw new Error('Search API requires HTTPS');const body=JSON.stringify({query:String(query).slice(0,2000),sourceClass,limit:Math.min(100,Math.max(1,Number(config.searchLimit)||35))});
      const headers={'content-type':'application/json','accept':'application/json'};
      if(config.searchApiKey)headers.authorization='Bearer '+config.searchApiKey;
      const response=await request(endpoint,{signal,method:'POST',headers,body,allowedDomains:[new URL(endpoint).hostname],maxRedirects:0});
      if(!/application\/(?:[\w.+-]*\+)?json/i.test(response.contentType))throw new Error('Search API returned unsupported content type');
      let parsed;try{parsed=JSON.parse(response.text);}catch{throw new Error('Search API returned invalid JSON');}
      if(!Array.isArray(parsed.results))throw new Error('Search API results contract is invalid');
      return {results:parsed.results.slice(0,100).filter(h=>h&&typeof h.url==='string').map(h=>({url:h.url.slice(0,4000),title:plain(h.title,500),snippet:plain(h.snippet,2000)}))};
    },
    /** @param {string} url @param {{signal?:AbortSignal}} options */
    async fetchPage(url,{signal}={}){
      if(!domains.length)throw new Error('Source domain allowlist is empty');
      const response=await request(url,{signal,headers:{accept:'text/html, application/xhtml+xml'},allowedDomains:domains,maxRedirects:Math.min(5,Math.max(0,config.maxRedirects==null?3:Number(config.maxRedirects)))});
      if(!/text\/html|application\/xhtml\+xml/i.test(response.contentType))throw new Error('Source page is not supported HTML');
      return {...extractProductEvidence(response.text),finalUrl:response.finalUrl,contentType:response.contentType,checkedAt:new Date().toISOString(),extractionMethod:'json-ld',verification:'observed'};
    }
  };
}
