function intelligenceDatabase(env){const key=env.TI_DB_BINDING_NAME;if(key&&!['WORKSPACE_DB','ADMIN_DB','COMMERCE_DB','DB','INTELLIGENCE_DB'].includes(key))return null;return key?env[key]:(env.INTELLIGENCE_DB||workspaceDB(env));}
function runtimeCapabilities(env){
 const errors=[];if(typeof env.TI_SERVICE_TOKEN!=='string'||env.TI_SERVICE_TOKEN.length<32)errors.push('Araştırma servis kimliği yapılandırılmadı.');if(intelligenceDatabase(env)&&intelligenceDatabase(env)!==workspaceDB(env))errors.push('Araştırma ve teklif aynı ZAMAN veri bağlantısını kullanmalıdır.');if(env.TI_ENABLED!=='1')errors.push('Ticari Zekâ ve Aksiyon henüz etkinleştirilmedi.');
 if(!intelligenceDatabase(env))errors.push('Ticari veri bağlantısı yapılandırılmadı.');if(typeof env.INTELLIGENCE_QUEUE?.send!=='function')errors.push('Arka plan görev kuyruğu yapılandırılmadı.');
 if(typeof env.TI_SEARCH?.fetch!=='function')errors.push('Canlı arama sağlayıcısı bağlanmadı.');if(typeof env.TI_COLLECTOR?.fetch!=='function')errors.push('Güvenli sayfa okuyucusu bağlanmadı.');
 let registry=[];try{registry=JSON.parse(env.TI_SOURCE_REGISTRY||JSON.stringify(ZAMAN_DISCOVERY_SEEDS));if(!Array.isArray(registry)||registry.length>100)throw Error();for(const s of registry){if(!s||typeof s.domain!=='string'||!['manufacturer','wholesaler','national_retail','local_retail','marketplace','distributor','catalog'].includes(s.sourceClass))throw Error();validatePublicUrl('https://'+s.domain)}}catch{errors.push('Araştırma kaynak listesi geçersiz.');registry=[];}
 return {architectureVersion:ZAMAN_ARCHITECTURE_LOCK.version,operationalVerified:false,configured:errors.length===0,execution:'background',commercialActions:'human_instruction_required',liveSearchConfigured:typeof env.TI_SEARCH?.fetch==='function',collectorConfigured:typeof env.TI_COLLECTOR?.fetch==='function',registeredSourceCount:registry.length,coverageClaim:'Yapılandırılmış kaynak ve sorgular; bütün internet kapsamı garantisi yok.',errors,registry};
}
const jsonResponse=(body,status=200)=>new Response(JSON.stringify(body),{status,headers:{'content-type':'application/json; charset=utf-8','cache-control':'private, no-store','x-robots-tag':'noindex, nofollow'}});
async function zamanIntelligenceRoute(request,env,auth,verifyWorkspace,workspaceDatabase){
 if(auth?.user?.role!=='owner'||!auth.user.id)return jsonResponse({ok:false,error:'OWNER_ONLY'},403);
 const DB=intelligenceDatabase(env);const capabilities=runtimeCapabilities(env);let schemaReady=false;if(DB&&DB===workspaceDB(env)){try{await workspaceEnsure(env);await ensureIntelligenceSchema(DB);schemaReady=true}catch{capabilities.configured=false;capabilities.errors.push('Araştırma kayıt tabloları hazırlanamadı.')}}const {registry,...publicCapabilities}=capabilities;
 if(new URL(request.url).pathname==='/api/workspace/intelligence/capabilities'&&request.method==='GET')return jsonResponse({ok:true,data:publicCapabilities});
 const researchPath=new URL(request.url).pathname;const startsResearch=request.method==='POST'&&(researchPath==='/api/workspace/intelligence/jobs'||/^\/api\/workspace\/intelligence\/jobs\/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\/retry$/.test(researchPath));
 if(!DB||!schemaReady||DB!==workspaceDatabase||startsResearch&&!capabilities.configured)return jsonResponse({ok:false,error:'INTELLIGENCE_NOT_CONFIGURED',message:'Canlı araştırma bağlantıları tamamlanmadan araştırma başlatılamaz.',details:capabilities.errors},503);
 const transferMatch=new URL(request.url).pathname.match(/^\/api\/workspace\/intelligence\/jobs\/([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\/transfer$/);
 if(transferMatch&&request.method==='POST'){
  if(workspaceDatabase!==DB)return jsonResponse({ok:false,error:'SHARED_DATABASE_REQUIRED'},503);
  try{const reader=request.body.getReader();let bytes=0,chunks=[];try{for(;;){const r=await reader.read();if(r.done)break;bytes+=r.value.byteLength;if(bytes>32000){await reader.cancel();return jsonResponse({ok:false,error:'PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE'},413)}chunks.push(r.value)}}finally{reader.releaseLock()}
   const data=new Uint8Array(bytes);let offset=0;for(const c of chunks){data.set(c,offset);offset+=c.length}const input=JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(data));
   const output=await persistReviewedTransfer(workspaceDatabase,createD1IntelligenceRepository(DB),String(auth.user.id),transferMatch[1],input);
   return jsonResponse({ok:true,data:output});
  }catch(e){return jsonResponse({ok:false,error:e.message},409)}
 }
 const router=createIntelligenceRouter({repository:createD1IntelligenceRepository(DB),queue:env.INTELLIGENCE_QUEUE,verifyWorkspace,researchConfigured:capabilities.configured});
 return router(request,{auth,securityVerified:{session:true,origin:true,csrf:true}});
}
/** Trusted service bindings hide credentials. Isolated Cloudflare collector checks public DNS on every hop; native fetch uses platform isolation, not connection-level DNS pinning. Deploy with global_fetch_strictly_public and no origin/private bindings. */
function bindingAdapters(env){
 if(!env.TI_SEARCH?.fetch||!env.TI_COLLECTOR?.fetch)return {};
 const invoke=async(binding,path,payload,signal)=>{const controller=new AbortController(),cancel=()=>controller.abort(signal.reason);if(signal?.aborted)throw signal.reason??Error('İşlem iptal edildi.');signal?.addEventListener('abort',cancel,{once:true});let timer;
 try{return await Promise.race([Promise.resolve().then(async()=>{const response=await binding.fetch('https://service.internal/'+path,{method:'POST',signal:controller.signal,headers:{'content-type':'application/json','authorization':'Bearer '+env.TI_SERVICE_TOKEN},body:JSON.stringify(payload)});if(!response.ok)throw Error('Araştırma servisi yanıt vermedi: '+response.status);if(Number(response.headers.get('content-length'))>2000000)throw Error('Araştırma yanıtı boyut sınırını aştı.');const reader=response.body?.getReader();if(!reader)throw Error('Araştırma servisi boş yanıt verdi.');let size=0,chunks=[];try{for(;;){const{done,value}=await reader.read();if(done)break;size+=value.byteLength;if(size>2000000){await reader.cancel();throw Error('Araştırma yanıtı boyut sınırını aştı.')}chunks.push(value)}}finally{reader.releaseLock()}const bytes=new Uint8Array(size);let offset=0;for(const chunk of chunks){bytes.set(chunk,offset);offset+=chunk.length}return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(bytes));}),new Promise((_,reject)=>{timer=setTimeout(()=>{controller.abort();reject(Error('Araştırma servisi zaman aşımına uğradı.'));},15000);controller.signal.addEventListener('abort',()=>reject(controller.signal.reason??Error('İşlem iptal edildi.')),{once:true});})])}finally{clearTimeout(timer);signal?.removeEventListener('abort',cancel)}};
 return {search:(query,{signal,sourceClass})=>invoke(env.TI_SEARCH,'search',{query,sourceClass},signal),
  resolveHost:(hostname,{signal})=>invoke(env.TI_COLLECTOR,'resolve',{hostname},signal).then(r=>r.addresses),
  fetchPage:(url,{signal})=>invoke(env.TI_COLLECTOR,'collect',{url:validatePublicUrl(url)},signal)};
}
async function zamanIntelligenceQueue(batch,env){
 const DB=intelligenceDatabase(env);const capabilities=runtimeCapabilities(env);if(!capabilities.configured){for(const message of batch.messages)message.retry({delaySeconds:60});return}try{await workspaceEnsure(env);await ensureIntelligenceSchema(DB)}catch{for(const message of batch.messages)message.retry({delaySeconds:60});return}
 const consume=createIntelligenceQueueConsumer({store:createD1QueueStore(DB),leaseMs:300000,
  runResearch:async job=>{const controller=new AbortController(),timer=setTimeout(()=>controller.abort(Object.assign(Error('Research overall deadline'),{code:'RESEARCH_DEADLINE'})),180000);let checking=false;const cancelPoll=setInterval(async()=>{if(checking)return;checking=true;try{const state=await createD1QueueStore(DB).state(job.ownerId,job.jobId);if(state!=='running')controller.abort(Error('Araştırma durduruldu.'))}catch{controller.abort(Error('Araştırma durumu doğrulanamadı.'))}finally{checking=false}},2000);try{
   const product=job.product;if(!product?.name)throw Error('Araştırma için ürün kimliği gerekli.');
   const result=await runTradeResearch({...product,packaging:product.packaging??product.pack},bindingAdapters(env),{registry:capabilities.registry,signal:controller.signal,maxResults:70,perDomainBudget:5,timeoutMs:12000});
   return {...result,evidence:result.records};
  }finally{clearTimeout(timer);clearInterval(cancelPoll)}}});
 for(const message of batch.messages){try{await consume(message)}catch{message.retry({delaySeconds:30})}}
}

/* ZAMAN ARCHITECTURE LOCK v1 — 2026-10-10 / Hasan Kaya
   Locked boundaries: owner-only private ZAMAN; shared authoritative D1;
   standalone research never creates/mutates a quote; public DENIZ is untouched;
   source observation never equals a confirmed commercial commitment;
   source/reason/product/package/VAT/currency/shipping + revision are required
   for cost transfer; transfer preserves current sale price; only customer-wide
   discount on editable quotes; historic immutable snapshots stay unchanged;
   no automatic message/order/publishing; deployment belongs to Hasan.
   Nine business pools below are a target contract, NOT a claim of completion.
   Seven web source classes are query scopes, NOT these business pools.
   External search/collector readiness and visual/mobile production behavior
   remain unverified until tested in the deployed environment.
*/
const ZAMAN_ARCHITECTURE_LOCK=Object.freeze({version:'ZAMAN-ARCH-1-2026-10-10',owner:'Hasan Kaya',pools:Object.freeze(['product','business','supplier','pricing_profit','quote_tools','contact','follow_up','business_development','strategy_action']),invariants:Object.freeze(['shared_zaman_database','standalone_does_not_mutate_quotes','reviewed_source_required','revision_required','preserve_sale_price','customer_discount_only','immutable_history','no_automatic_external_actions','hasan_controls_deployment'])});
const intelligenceSchemaPending=new WeakMap();

// Pure additive architecture helpers. No network, persistence, routes or external actions.
const ZAMAN_COMMAND_CONTRACTS = (() => {
  const freeze = value => { if(value && typeof value === 'object'){Object.values(value).forEach(freeze);Object.freeze(value);}return value; };
  const productClasses=['manufacturer','wholesaler','national_retail','local_retail','marketplace','distributor','catalog'];
  const businessClasses=['official_company','official_registry','industry_association','trade_directory','national_retail','local_retail','distributor','wholesaler'];
  const contactClasses=['official_company','official_registry','manufacturer','distributor','wholesaler','industry_association','trade_directory'];
  return freeze({version:1,pools:['product','business','supplier','pricing_profit','quote_tools','contact','follow_up','business_development','strategy_action'],commands:{
    'product.research':{pool:'product',required:['query'],sourceClasses:productClasses,kind:'observation'},
    'business.research':{pool:'business',required:['query','region'],sourceClasses:businessClasses,kind:'observation'},
    'contact.research':{pool:'contact',required:['query','entityId'],sourceClasses:contactClasses,kind:'observation'},
    'follow_up.research':{pool:'follow_up',required:['query','entityId','linkedResearchCommand'],sourceClasses:[],kind:'observation'}
  },forbiddenAutomaticEffects:['send_message','place_order','publish_price','commit_cost','adopt_contact'],gateChecks:['nine_pool_persistence','nine_pool_commands','nine_pool_ui','cross_pool_links','owner_isolation','session_origin_csrf','revision_idempotency','shared_database','immutable_audit','research_command_routes','source_class_provider_contracts','live_provider_smoke','evidence_provenance','human_commercial_review','quote_invariants']});
})();
function planZamanResearchCommand(command,input){
  const contract=ZAMAN_COMMAND_CONTRACTS.commands[command];if(!contract)throw Error('UNKNOWN_COMMAND');
  if(!input||typeof input!=='object'||Array.isArray(input))throw Error('INVALID_INPUT');
  for(const key of contract.required)if(typeof input[key]!=='string'||!input[key].trim()||input[key].length>500||/[\u0000-\u001f]/.test(input[key]))throw Error('REQUIRED_'+key.toUpperCase());
  let classes=contract.sourceClasses;
  if(command==='follow_up.research'){
    const linked=ZAMAN_COMMAND_CONTRACTS.commands[input.linkedResearchCommand];
    if(!linked||input.linkedResearchCommand==='follow_up.research')throw Error('INVALID_LINKED_RESEARCH_COMMAND');
    classes=linked.sourceClasses;
  }
  const phrases={manufacturer:'üretici resmi ürün kataloğu',wholesaler:'toptancı tedarik',national_retail:'ulusal market ürün',local_retail:'yerel market ürün',marketplace:'ürün satış fiyat',distributor:'distribütör bayi',catalog:'resmi katalog teknik ambalaj',official_company:'resmi firma faaliyet iletişim',official_registry:'ticaret sicil resmi kayıt',industry_association:'sektör derneği üye firma',trade_directory:'ticaret firma rehberi'};
  const query=input.query.trim(),region=typeof input.region==='string'?input.region.trim():'';
  return {contractVersion:1,command,pool:contract.pool,entityId:input.entityId||null,requiresOwner:true,mutatesCommercialData:false,externalActions:[],queries:classes.map(sourceClass=>({sourceClass,query:[query,phrases[sourceClass],region].filter(Boolean).join(' ')})),coverageRequirements:classes.map(sourceClass=>({sourceClass,status:'not_executed',attemptRequired:true,sourceIdentity:'unverified'})),notice:'A query plan is not executed research or verified source coverage.'};
}
function evaluateZamanPassGate(checks,{now=new Date().toISOString()}={}){
  if(!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(now)))throw Error('INVALID_GATE_TIME');
  const items=ZAMAN_COMMAND_CONTRACTS.gateChecks.map(id=>{
    const evidence=checks?.[id];const verified=evidence?.status==='PASS'&&typeof evidence.scenarioId==='string'&&evidence.scenarioId.trim()&&typeof evidence.evidenceRef==='string'&&evidence.evidenceRef.trim()&&Number.isFinite(Date.parse(evidence.checkedAt))&&Date.parse(evidence.checkedAt)<=Date.parse(now);
    return {id,status:verified?'PASS':'FAIL',reason:verified?null:evidence?.reason||'Missing verified scenario and evidence',evidenceRef:verified?evidence.evidenceRef:null};
  });
  const passed=items.every(item=>item.status==='PASS');return {gate:'ZAMAN',status:passed?'PASS':'FAIL',checkedAt:now,items,nextPhases:{DENIZ:passed?'eligible':'blocked',mobile:passed?'eligible':'blocked'},operationalVerified:passed};
}

 const checkedAt=new Date().toISOString();
 const settled=await Promise.allSettled(plans.map(async plan=>{
  const u=new URL('https://serpapi.com/search.json');for(const [k,v]of Object.entries({engine:plan.engine,q:plan.q,hl:'tr',gl:'tr',api_key:key}))u.searchParams.set(k,v);
  const controller=new AbortController(),cancel=()=>controller.abort();request.signal.addEventListener('abort',cancel,{once:true});if(request.signal.aborted)controller.abort();const timer=setTimeout(cancel,18000);
  try{const response=await fetch(u.href,{signal:controller.signal,headers:{accept:'application/json'},redirect:'manual'}).catch(error=>{if(error.name==='AbortError')throw error;throw Error('Sağlayıcıya erişilemedi.')});if(response.status>=300&&response.status<400){await response.body?.cancel();throw Error('Arama sağlayıcısı yönlendirme döndürdü; güvenlik nedeniyle takip edilmedi.')}if(!response.ok){await response.body?.cancel();throw Error(response.status===401||response.status===403?'API anahtarı kabul edilmedi.':response.status===429?'API kotası veya istek sınırı doldu.':'Arama sağlayıcısı HTTP '+response.status+' döndürdü.')}
   let data;try{data=JSON.parse(await boundedText(response,2*1024*1024,controller.signal))}catch{throw Error('Sağlayıcı yanıtı okunamadı.')}
   if(data.error){if(/no results|didn.t return any results/i.test(String(data.error)))return [];throw Error('Sağlayıcı aramayı tamamlayamadı; API hesabı ve kota kontrolü gerekli.')}
   const raw=plan.engine==='google_shopping'?(data.shopping_results||[]):(data.organic_results||[]);
   if(!Array.isArray(raw))throw Error('Sağlayıcı sonuç biçimi geçersiz.');
   return raw.filter(row=>row&&typeof row==='object').slice(0,40).map(row=>{const url=okySearchSafeLink(row.product_link||row.link);return {title:plain(row.title,500),source:plain(row.source||(url?new URL(url).hostname:''),200),url,price:typeof row.price==='string'?plain(row.price,100):null,snippet:plain(row.snippet,2000),kind:plan.engine==='google_shopping'?'Fiyat gözlemi':'Kaynak sonucu',verification:'observed',vatStatus:'unknown',stockStatus:'unknown'}}).filter(row=>row.title&&row.url);
  }catch(error){if(error.name==='AbortError')throw Error('Kaynak yanıt süresi doldu.');throw error}finally{clearTimeout(timer);request.signal.removeEventListener('abort',cancel)}
 }));
 const coverage=settled.map((item,i)=>({label:plans[i].label,ok:item.status==='fulfilled',count:item.status==='fulfilled'?item.value.length:0,message:item.status==='rejected'?item.reason.message:null}));
 const seen=new Set(),results=settled.flatMap(item=>item.status==='fulfilled'?item.value:[]).filter(row=>{const id=row.url+'|'+(row.price||'');if(seen.has(id))return false;seen.add(id);return true}).sort((a,b)=>Number(Boolean(b.price))-Number(Boolean(a.price)));
 if(settled.every(item=>item.status==='rejected'))return jsonResponse({ok:false,error:'SEARCH_FAILED',message:coverage.map(row=>row.label+': '+row.message).join(' '),coverage},502);
 let persistenceWarning=null;
 try{if(!DB)throw Error('DB_UNAVAILABLE');await okyInlineEnsure(DB);await DB.prepare('INSERT INTO oky_inline_search_v1(id,owner_id,query,payload_json,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)').bind(crypto.randomUUID(),String(auth.user.id),query,JSON.stringify({results,coverage,checkedAt}),checkedAt).run()}catch{persistenceWarning='Sonuçlar gösterildi, ancak araştırma geçmişine kaydedilemedi.'}
 return jsonResponse({ok:true,query,results,coverage,checkedAt,persistenceWarning});
}

async function okyInlineEnsure(DB){await DB.prepare('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oky_inline_search_v1(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,query TEXT NOT NULL,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL)').run();await DB.prepare('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS oky_inline_search_owner_date_v1 ON oky_inline_search_v1(owner_id,created_at)').run()}
